envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes, testkit.refusal-wire
World owns HOME, the XDG roots and TMPDIR; every subprocess goes through run with a timeout; Result.refusal() asserts the wire. findings.py and correction.py are staged through World.stage with instrument.py and laneconf.py beside them (HANDOFF-2026-09-13-wall-migration.md). No planted fake tool (this module has none). Kit gap: World.stage always lands under world.root/stage/, so the proven copy is also planted at repo/ops/conductor/tools so the printed needed command resolves. No regression rows were added because this was a behavior-preserving migration.
